text:
claire: Kickoff for LumosPay customer story. Goal: 20s quoted line + ~10m interview clip to fuel a July 14 launch post and webinar promo. Who's free next week to record?

diego: Morning slots work for me. I can draft three caption variants (one numeric, two conservative).

rachel: For distribution, we want the asset to drive webinar RSVPs and a parallel paid demo CTA. Will split CTAs by channel.

marta: Legal needs a signed release before publish and explicit quote approval before social. If you plan to use metrics, Research must post the backing doc. Post the draft quote here and I'll flag any wording issues.

claire: Draft quote: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~4x, which freed up budget to accelerate feature releases."

ayan: Ran the LumosPay runs last month. Median cost improvement = 3.92x on their transaction workload (50k sample). OK to use "~4x" if we attach the CSV + one-paragraph methodology. I'll upload to Drive and paste link.

marta: With Research doc we can approve the "~4x" phrasing but require a parenthetical link on the landing page and a one-sentence methodology line. Also suggest changing "freed up budget" -> "reallocated spend" to avoid implying causal steps we can't document.

rachel: Ops/Routing: webinar RSVPs should map to SFDC campaign 'LumosPay Launch Jul' and go to SDR queue 'Fintech-MidMarket'. Paid clicks -> demo form; organic -> webinar RSVP. Can we add hidden fields utm_source, utm_campaign, ad_paid=true/false?

ops-bot: Created ticket asset-33077. Checklist: book recording, signed release, quote approval, attach benchmark link, set UTM + SFDC mapping. Required SFDC mapping: CampaignMemberStatus='Registered', custom fields utm_source/utm_campaign/ad_paid_flag.

claire: Revised quote per Legal: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~4x and helped us reallocate spend to ship features faster." Agree?

diego: I'll prepare caption versions: numeric (uses ~4x with link), conservative ("significantly lower costs"), and hybrid (uses percentage language avoided).

ayan: Uploaded report: https://drive.redwood/reports/lumospay-benchmark.csv and README. Methodology snippet: "50k-request sample, median per-request cost, identical model config per baseline." Paste the one-liner on the landing page and link to the report.

marta: Reviewed wording: approve the revised quote. I'll drop the release template and quick redlines into the ticket. Need the signed release before we record.

claire: Proposed recording: Tue 7/6 9:30am PT, 25-minute block (tech check + recording). I'll attach pre-interview brief, consent form, UTM spec, and SFDC campaign name to the ticket. Tagging @rachel for routing handoff.

rachel: Will coordinate SFDC mapping and ensure forms populate the campaign.

claire: Thanks team  locking calendar and will post final assets to the intake ticket. :sparkles:
